name: OPPAACHA
tagline: Music producer & DJ. Owner of Become Human Records
bio: Behind Oppaacha is Vladislav Liuborets, whose relationship with electronic music dates back to 2007. At just 12 years old, he discovered trance and EDM and began making his first tracks.

By 2021, he had completely rethought his approach to production and created Oppaacha, a project focused on a more underground club sound, while keeping the influence of the ’90s and 2000s that had shaped his musical taste from the beginning.

Perhaps it was this balance between past and present that caught Solomun’s attention. Over the following three years, Oppaacha had five releases on Diynamic and spent two consecutive years among the label’s Top 10 artists.
musicHighlights: Support from Tiësto, Solomun, CamelPhat, Steve Angello, Pete Tong
Music played at Tomorrowland, EDC, Ultra
